eras.title: The Last War
eras.subtitle: A century of shifting alliances and death

events.title: King Jarot Dies, the War Begins
events.summary: King Jarot of Galifar dies. His children reject their eldest sister's claim and the Five Nations turn Jarot's armies on each other.
events.detail: The crown should have passed to Princess Mishann of Cyre. Prince Thalin of Thrane, Prince Kaius of Karrnath and Princess Wroann of Breland refused her, and Prince Wrogar of Aundair's support was not enough. The Five Nations used the armies and new technologies Jarot had amassed to wage war on one another. Nearly a century later the fighting has still not ended.

events.title: House Cannith Builds Flying Fortresses
events.summary: Giant flying military bases take to the skies for the war effort.
events.detail: House Cannith created the flying fortresses in 912 YK. Each is a floating base populated by military personnel under permanent military protocol. Ten are currently deployed by the Brelish military.

events.title: The Grimdell Family Disappears
events.summary: Twenty years into the war, the Grimdell necromancy family vanishes from sight.
events.detail: Grave, Gelyia, Grail, Gelion and Geraldine Grimdell were already a known problem before they disappeared. Decades later they resurface working for House Thuranni, the entertainment house that fronts for assassins and thieves. Their mother is said to always be trying new things with necklaces.

events.title: Brand Broadhelm Framed for Treason
events.summary: Brand refuses Thaddeus Cannith the plans to his suit. Thaddeus frames him for a Thranish plot against the King.
events.detail: Brand and Thaddeus D'Cannith were once friendly rivals. When Brand would not hand over his power suit blueprints, Thaddeus framed him for aiding an assassination attempt on King Boranex. Convicted under the old king, Brand spent the next forty years in prison. Ember's packages never reached him and the Broadhelm forge fell to paranoia without him.

events.title: The Warforged Are Created
events.summary: House Cannith builds living constructs in Cyre to fight the war. They have free will.
events.detail: Warforged are an artificial race of sentient constructs. Clockwork, the Sentinels' artificer, was built to be a Sentinel and builds warforged of his own. The Even Hand and Mustang will prove how far the technology has come.

events.title: The Day the Walls Fell
events.summary: Six days of fighting in Wroat. The Dragons of Centarrel are killed and the dragons leave Khorvaire.
events.detail: The graves in the Tomb of Centarrel are dated from the 8th to the 13th of Eyre 968. High Marshall Elmor Daerthane, Thaldamir's father, and Cedric Ironhard, Gelf's father, both fought and died with the troops. After the dragons were killed the rest of their kind abandoned Khorvaire. Only the pulp-named Steve the Skycracker and Bob the Blazebringer still police the Dagger River skies.

events.title: The Guns of Wroat Are Raised
events.summary: Breland arms its capital after the walls fell.
events.detail: The great guns ring the wall of Wroat beside Brokenblade Castle, where the King resides, and the Citadel, where the High Marshalls direct the war. The party sees them on the Kingsblade's approach. The Dreamweaver later tries to crash the Kingsblade into that Citadel.

events.title: The King Founds the Sentinels
events.summary: A top-secret extra-judicial special forces unit answerable only to the King and the five High Marshalls.
events.detail: Sentinel teams choose their own missions and are held accountable for them. It is easier to ask forgiveness than permission. A gold badge grants authority with no questions asked. Brand remembers the name being floated when he was counsel to the old king, though the project was not approved at that meeting.

events.title: Willow Disappears
events.summary: The shifter elder who warned the young ones to stop embezzling from Aundair vanishes.
events.detail: After Sazed was captured, the younger shifters grew reckless and stole directly from the Aundairian government. Willow warned them and then was never seen again. Without her the elders fled to Breland, and Falken Sagewood founded the hidden village of Hearthsfire.

events.title: First Elemental Airship in Combat
events.summary: House Lyrandar's elemental airships fly into battle for the first time.
events.detail: An elemental ring, bound by Lyrandar magic, lifts the ship. Most are owned by the Aundairian military; a few belong to privateers. Within three years Breland fields Galifar-class ships like the Kingsblade and the Pillar of Dawn.

events.title: Lirael Sr Fixates on the Dreamweaver
events.summary: A general and wizard becomes convinced someone in the Brelish military is trying to capture the Dreamweaver.
events.detail: Lirael Sr, head of the Ardev magic society, turns its whole focus to the Dreamweaver and the Shadow Mirror he believes can control it. He stops eating, stops his duties, dismisses his guard and is discharged after investigating his superiors. His wife sends Lirael Jr to follow him to a warlock cult in Starilaskur, the Watchers of the Gate.

events.title: Lirael Sr Vanishes
events.summary: A year and a half after his obsession began, the general simply disappears.
events.detail: The Sharn magic society denies he ever arrived. His library books are never returned. He had spoken to Blazehelm about the Shadow Mirror shortly before. One last poem in his journal points at a black obelisk: light the way and it will show.

events.title: Massacre of the Watchers of the Gate
events.summary: During a ritual in the Witches Waltz, Lirael is possessed and tears the warlock cult apart.
events.detail: Grand Warlock Maldroc Daelmourn led the celestial warlocks of the Fury through a ritual in which the mirrors became doorways into the astral sea. The Dreamweaver entered Lirael and he killed the Watchers, leaving nothing but gore, then burned their library. He later assassinated Vena Belladonna, head of the magic society, and was imprisoned. Only the young wizard Gelard Greenly saw the possession and he was barred from testifying.

events.title: Glade Founds Stones Throw
events.summary: Glade Amberwood breaks from Hearthsfire to build a shifter village closer to Brelish society.
events.detail: Falken Sagewood warned him it was not safe. Glade kicked the Covenant of Emberfall out after a disagreement and, by rumour, let changelings in. A year later the village burns.

events.title: Bravewind Attacked
events.summary: A changeling village near Ardev is raided and its people fed through a portal.
events.detail: A revived Flock changeling remembers running, being kidnapped, put through a portal and possessed. His orders were to disguise himself, deceive, steal, kill, kidnap drow and kill a dwarf and a shifter. The Flock are the Dreamweaver's expendable hands.

events.title: Royal Ardev Regiment Destroys the Portal
events.summary: Under a black order, Captain Flowers' regiment bombs an ancient teleportation circle in the Boranex forest as a Balor steps through.
events.detail: The cover story was a training exercise for a torch-and-burn op in Thrane. The regiment, conscripts from Lirael's village, used a Broadhelm concussion bomb on the circle. The demons stranded on this side became the quasit village that robs Hobbstweedle. Nobody knows who sent the order.

events.title: The Regiment Is Disbanded
events.summary: Four days after the exercise the Royal Ardev Regiment is scattered across the country, still drawing pay.
events.detail: Captain Flowers is sent to Ardev to replace a police captain who had just died. Murphy Gravewood, Gauss Hog and Kal Valvier stay in Wroat waiting for reassignment. All three are hunted by the Even Hand within the month.

events.title: Stones Throw Massacre
events.summary: Young Silver Flame warriors come from all sides in the dead of night and burn the shifter village.
events.detail: The corpses bear radiant burns. Carrk Moonrunner, the Ring of Siberys, was lured away by a Covenant druid disguised as his fox totem and returned too late. Eight small children and ten-year-old Skye Amberwood hide in the well for a week.

events.title: Train to DarkWood
events.summary: Three criminals wake in the dark of a prison train. The carriage opens on woods, a new prison, and chanting: fresh fish.
events.detail: Brand rides with Tauren Thickcock, Scud Barlowe and Elarian; Lirael and Sazed with Leff and Rolick Erenside. Somewhere far away a grizzled wizard with a raven reads from a locked book: it is criminals who hold the quill now. In his bunk Lirael pulls a rock from the wall and Brand recognises a sending stone behind it. In the cafeteria the elf Thaldamir Daerthane snaps his fingers and everyone rolls initiative.

events.title: Initiation Night Becomes a Prison Break
events.summary: Told to fight each other one on one, the prisoners turn their weapons on the guards instead. Bloodworth dies and the alarm is pulled.
events.detail: Officer Bloodworth had tortured Sazed and taken everyone's gear: Elarian's pendant, Sazed's book Whispers of Wind and Grass, Brand's holy symbol. Lirael had been playing Cromwell on the sending stone to Sheldor Higgins. At the newbie fight the party kills Bloodworth and his goons; Fumble Figgins runs. Tauren falls, Scud flees, Shmem Gorgis dies and his send-off nearly burns the prison down. Byll and Cyriel are put to sleep and spared.

events.title: Warden Sharpe's Confession
events.summary: The prison is an experiment turning ex-Brelish soldiers into zombies for an attack on Karrnath.
events.detail: Lirael talks the party past a barricade of frightened young officers and through the officer lounge into the warden's office. Sharpe says the army has been hollowed out and the High Marshalls deceived, but he does not know who he works for. The record keeper Erald Dwelve names the necromancer: Grail Grimdell. The party chains Thaldamir to a wall after he begs for his life and promises millions of gold.

events.title: Brand Suits Up
events.summary: The gear is found at last and Brand does an awesome iron man transition into his power armor.
events.detail: The secret inventory room holds thieves' tools, Elarian's pendant, Sazed's book and Oath Watcher pendant, Brand's suit and holy symbol, and a tarp-covered mirror. The mirror gives everyone nightmares until Sazed smashes it. A friendly mimic named Chester only wants to see how good they are at lockpicking and, impressed, hands over a bag of holding. The party ignores a fire in the secretary's office, which spreads.

events.title: Grail Grimdell Raises the Dead
events.summary: In the burning prison yard the necromancer thanks the party for so many beautiful corpses. Everyone they killed stands up.
events.detail: The party rescues Keys, Faird, Sorenson, Tauren, Leff and Rolick from the cafeteria; Elarian is blown out through the wall. They rappel into the yard and Rex joins them as Grail Grimdell steps out to offer them a place at his side. Zombie Bloodworth, zombie Shmem, zombie Scud and the warden rise with the rest. The zombies overwhelm Brand while Rolick is killed. Brand kills Grail and every zombie drops, until the necklace on Grail's corpse raises him again, more deranged and more powerful, with his dead now remembering their lives.

events.title: Brain to Anus: Grail Falls
events.summary: Lirael brings Damron Pink's guards back into the fight, Sazed smashes zombie Bloodworth's skull for the third time, and Brand's seeking shot ends Grail for good.
events.detail: Grail goes invisible and uses undead meat shields to turn Brand's attacks on his own zombies. Rex dies and rises. Lirael convinces Damron Pink to open the gate and send guards despite having killed all his friends, and returns with Fumble Figgins. Zombie Rolick, Rex, Scud, Shmem, Magnot and Warden Sharpe are put down one by one. Afterwards Lirael feather-falls Byll, Cyriel and Chester off the roof and lets Thaldamir drop and break his leg; Brand knocks him out and everyone spits in his face.

events.title: Cool Guys Don't Look at Explosions
events.summary: The armory goes up and DarkWood Prison explodes behind the party. For the first time in a long time they are free.
events.detail: Sheldor Higgins charges out of the flaming entrance leading prisoners and calling for Cromwell. Lirael admits he was Cromwell on the stone; Sheldor has not heard from his friend in weeks. On Grail's body they find the necklace that raises its wearer as a zombie possessed by Grail, and a note signed DDT summoning him to the hidden mountain village of Mara'bor. Damron Pink lets them take horses and carriages and swears to kill them if he ever sees them again. Sheldor teaches Lirael the drow handshake Snel Katar on the road.

events.title: DDT and the Road to Mara'bor
events.summary: Brand remembers Mara'bor from a childhood book. Elric Galen knows the way in.
events.detail: The party rides with Elric, Halien, Tauren, Leff, Sorenson, Keys, Faird, Erald, Sheldor and Chester the mimic. At the mine entrance they deceive the guards Spingel and Joerick. Halien sends the other NPCs somewhere else and stands watch while Elric takes the party down a wild cart ride into the mountain. Someone has the brain blast that DDT is the D before a dragonmarked house name.

events.title: Elric Reveals the Sentinels
events.summary: Over a home-cooked meal, Elric admits Halien is really Gelf Ironhard and that both are Sentinels who sent the party to prison on purpose.
events.detail: Sazed asks for clothes instead of prison fatigues and Elric hands him a black covert ops uniform. Lirael casts detect thoughts while the party plies Elric with questions. The Sentinels are an extra-judicial Brelish military unit; the prison was a trial, and the party passed. Brand recalls the name from a council meeting with the old king. When Elric realises someone has read his mind he throws a spoon at Lirael. Everyone sleeps at 6:30 in the morning.

events.title: Grail's Cellar and the Bag of Devouring
events.summary: Under the abandoned house the party finds Grail's black-and-purple lair, a map of five Yedani prisons, and learns the hard way their bag eats things.
events.detail: After searching Warden Sharpe's widow's house and spying on Damron yelling at his guards, the party lures Spingel and Joerick with an illusion of Bloodworth's voice, puts them to sleep and ties them up. The cellar holds a painting of the Grimdell family, the sigil of House D'Thuranni and a goth sending stone. Sazed tries to stow the painting and is dragged inside by tentacles; he passes his strength check and climbs out. The 11,000 gold they had stored is gone. Lirael calls Grail's brother on the stone and arranges a midnight meeting.

events.title: Rotten Potatoes
events.summary: Damron searches the abandoned house. A minor illusion of a crawl space full of rotten potatoes fools him; Fumble Figgins wants to eat them.
events.detail: Gelf, hurt after fleeing Damron's guards and a gelatinous cube, hides behind Elric's secret closet door and laughs that Elric lost their bet by spilling the Sentinels. He explains House D'Thuranni's entertainment front and the Grimdells' return. Major Blazehelm has offers for each of them. The party lies in wait in the cellar with Elric and Gelf as midnight approaches.

events.title: Gelion Grimdell Goes in the Bag
events.summary: Lirael wears the necklace and convinces Grail's brother he is Grail reborn, then kicks him down the hatch. The only way to win is the bag.
events.detail: Gelion wonders why a reincarnated Grail is not a zombie, but Lirael sells it; mother was always trying new things with the necklaces. When Gelion offers to zombify Lirael's friends himself, the beating begins. He conjures skeletons, goes invisible, and after Sazed tears the necklace from a skeleton Gelion downs him, dons it and kills himself to rise as an awakened zombie. Brand heals Sazed and piledrives Gelion into the Bag of Devouring; Lirael holds it open. Gelion screams as he is eaten. The bag burps.

events.title: The Kingsblade Revealed
events.summary: Mara'bor is deserted. On the walk out, something huge bellows overhead, and in a clearing a massive illusion falls away to reveal an airship.
events.detail: The families of Mara'bor have fled and the horses are gone. Blue and red lights move in the overcast sky as something screams toward the mountain. Soldiers appear from nowhere; Gelf trades barbs with Chief Petty Officer Smildar Paxon, who was enjoying how quiet the Kingsblade was without him. Crossing the threshold, the party sees the Galifar-class Kingsblade on its maiden voyage. A gangway opens and Major Renaud Blazehelm welcomes them into the Sentinels.

events.title: Blazehelm's Three Offers
events.summary: In a tent below the airship, the Major lays out what the Sentinels know about each of them and what they can give.
events.detail: Sazed spied for Aundair but betrayed them to save Brelish people; Blazehelm counts that as serving Breland, and warns that the Silver Flame may have started a new inquisition. Brand was framed and the Major wants to clear his name and shield his inventions from Thaddeus Cannith. Lirael was possessed when he assassinated the head of the magic society, and his father vanished hunting the Shadow Mirror the Sentinels also want. DDT is Deckard D'Thuranni, head of the house. The sounds overhead were Aundairians under Captain Killian Gavrin, Blazehelm's self-declared archrival.

events.title: Found You
events.summary: After a drunken feast where Lirael becomes a chicken chased by gnomes, all three dream of their pasts, and a giant eye looks down and says two words.
events.detail: The party drinks with their prison friends aboard the Kingsblade, tours the dwarven engine hull and the halfling Shuriken fighter deck, and meets the pilot Screech from the northern village of Canuck. Black Sentinel outfits and new armor plates are issued. Sazed confesses to Nedira the shifter bridge officer that he was an Aundairian spy. Sazed dreams of soldiers fireballing his childhood hut, Lirael of his father trapped behind a mirror, Brand of the Broadhelm forge renamed House Cannith. Before waking, each sees the eye.

events.title: Broadaxe Destroyed, Broadsword Stolen
events.summary: An invisible Sazed rides the Broadaxe's rotor to plant a smokepowder charge while Brand and Screech leap from a waterfall onto the Broadsword.
events.detail: The valley run is a chase: dire wolves and a stray dog, a hobgoblin squad, a harpy put to sleep, a dwarf named EEEEE out of a can, a bear trap and an owlbear pit. At the river Lirael casts feather fall and the party jumps. Lirael falls short into the Aundairian camp, becomes a chicken and flies up through the landing gear. The Broadaxe's elemental cell explodes and a furious smoke elemental pours out. Brand thunderwaves the deck clear, Sazed removes the pilot, and Brand shoves the loyal Aundairian overboard with orders to tell people of him. Screech takes the controls.

events.title: Wroat, Hobbstweedle and Blazehelm's Party
events.summary: The Kunai dropship saves them, a second prison explodes with zombies, and the Kingsblade races to Wroat. The stolen ship is renamed the Moonwatch.
events.detail: Foehammer drops Tauren, Leff, Sorenson, Keys and a very alive Cromwell onto the Broadsword's deck. The Pillar of Dawn joins the Kingsblade to shell the zombies pouring from a second Yedani prison. Over Wroat the party sees the Guns, Brokenblade Castle and the Citadel, then lands in the Boranex forest village of Hobbstweedle. At the Major's mansion they meet Foehammer, the cleric Eloria and the warforged artificer Clockwork, hear how Blazehelm learned their histories, and Lirael drinks goblin piss in dwarven roulette. Brand makes a bullywug bandleader named Smarmy Joe his best friend.

events.title: The Flooded House Test
events.summary: The party wakes to a flooding bedroom, metal plates on every door, warforged enforcers in the dining room and a polar bear in the ceiling.
events.detail: Brand seals the spout with the Bag of Devouring and later bolts it down. Keys turns into a bear to break a door. Sazed rips a rune from a construct's heart and Brand recognises Clockwork's work: this is training. Lirael asks his reflection to step aside to pass a mirrored door, a red key opens the first lock, and an arrow that breaks a glass case also hits the red button that starts a timer beside a young kruthik. Mixing blue and yellow potions reveals an invisible key. Drill Instructor Dyll Strickland is waiting outside with nicknames nobody wants.

events.title: Thunderwave Through the Demon Village
events.summary: Invisible, the party picks off imps and a cambion, then Brand walks straight up to a quasit and the whole village swarms his shield.
events.detail: Sazed had tracked the quasits robbing the house to a village of imps and cambions in the Boranex forest. Gelf requisitions invisibility potions and cigars. Over a dozen demons fail to scratch Brand before Lirael's thunderwave kills nearly all of them. The last cambion briefly seizes Lirael and Sazed's minds and confesses the demons came through a portal that broke behind them. Loot includes bells of jingling and a bag of seven magic beans; the first bean becomes a geyser of excellent coffee.

events.title: The Broken Teleportation Circle
events.summary: A path from the village leads to a ruined circle covered in runes nobody has seen, destroyed by tremendous force.
events.detail: Lirael sketches it on a napkin for Gelf, who has never seen anything like it. Paxon arrives with a book on ancient teleportation and nerds out: it matches other ancient circles, some recently reactivated, and a powerful wizard could restore it. Gelard Greenly might know where it leads, but he has disappeared. Brand and Sazed decide Paxon is kind of cool. Erald reports the High Marshalls had no record of the prison and have opened an investigation; Paxon farted through the entire briefing.

events.title: Sheldor Shoves Brand in the Bag
events.summary: Brand wakes held down by two Sentinels under a silence spell while Sheldor forces him into the Bag of Devouring, where something begins eating his mind.
events.detail: Earlier that night baby morkoths crawled out of the bag to steal Brand's tools and the household hauled them out on ropes; Sheldor was oddly eager to climb in after the loot. Inside the bag the Dreamweaver assaults Brand's mind. He frees one hand and blows the Horn of Silent Alarm. Sazed, shoved in after him, holds off the attack and throws Brand out. Keys mauls the Sentinel spellcaster Lug Murzog to death. Under suggestion Sheldor admits he is possessed; reading the other Sentinel's mind Lirael hears a voice say, good, they believe you, then tell him Gelf and Elric.

events.title: The Dreamweaver Speaks Through Two Men
events.summary: Behind an illusory two-way mirror, Gelf and Elric's interrogation collapses when the thing inside Sheldor and Charlie Trundle addresses everyone by name.
events.detail: Gelf calls a code orange and Blazehelm locks down the mansion, keeping the possession secret even from the High Marshalls. Paxon spends a diamond and six months of forged records to revive Lug Murzog, who proves clean under detect thoughts. The Dreamweaver talks through both prisoners at once, mocks what the party whispers behind the glass, says Brand's threat is already too late, and tells them all to kill themselves. Feldor and Eloria propose entering the victims' dreams. At the Wroat military library Lirael learns every Dreamweaver book was checked out by his father before he vanished.

events.title: Every Book Checked Out by Lirael Sr
events.summary: The military library's Dreamweaver shelf is empty. The late fees are enormous and the borrower was a discharged general.
events.detail: Lirael flashes his badge and gets a copy of his father's credentials, which list him as a general and gloss over a discharge for conspiracy theories. Sazed finds shifter books bound in bark and nature fibre, looted from clans cleansed in the inquisition, and is enraged. Everyone gets a library card. Sazed takes out The Adventures of Beren Serpenswallow so he can secretly teach Tauren to read.

events.title: Possessed Brand Stalks Hobbstweedle
events.summary: At midnight the Dreamweaver walks Brand out of the house, screaming behind his own eyes, to drag Elric, Screech and Gelf into the bag one by one.
events.detail: Elric breaks first. Screech follows. Gelf, asleep beside the dragonborn Bellatrix Snaggletooth, fights free and resists every intrusion; in the bag he and Brand brawl until Brand shoves him off the ledge into the Astral Sea, Gelf swearing to kick his ass as he floats away. Screech shoots Bellatrix in the back as she flees. Disguised as Gelf, Brand answers Clockwork's question of whether everything is Hunky Dory with the wrong reply, and the warforged come through the back door. Brand lights the house with the book of fire and runs for the airfield.

events.title: Kingsblade Hijack Foiled
events.summary: Sheldor and Charlie Trundle murder their jailers and start the Kingsblade's lift-off. Cromwell turns the ship off from the lawn.
events.detail: Lirael, Sazed and Cromwell help Clockwork run down the possessed Brand, Elric and Screech at the village gate; Lirael puts Brand to sleep in an alley. At the jail the guards are dead and the prisoners gone. Bloody tracks lead to the airfield where the gangway guards lie dead. On the bridge Charlie kills the head of engineering Monty O'Brien as the ship begins to rise; Blazehelm warns the Kingsblade will be shot down if it flies. Later Brand is killed and revived to free his mind; Paxon arrives with the diamond asking if they could not have waited. The Dreamweaver wanted the Kingsblade to crash into the Citadel.

events.title: Bombing the Dream Eater
events.summary: Linked by dream spells, the party enters a black rocky plane where their friends sit caged. Lirael lights a short fuse on a smokepowder satchel.
events.detail: Clockwork, who cannot dream, lassos Gelf out of the Astral Sea first. In the dream a swirling monster paralyses Brand and Lirael, and floating orbs gather into two staring eyes. The bomb deals 165 force damage and kills the Dream Eater. A brass dragon erupts from the light and gouges out the eyes of the featureless face in the mist. Cromwell picks the cage's chain with mage hand, the platforms crumble under grasping hands, and the dragon's tail drags the face into the dark as the party leaps through the portal. Everyone wakes themselves again.

events.title: Fireworks Over Hobbstweedle
events.summary: Blazehelm gives a speech from a circular podium and casts detect good and evil behind the biggest explosion. No one else in the village is possessed.
events.detail: The party is added to Blazehelm's personal guard. Mind-control training follows: Lirael answers the first three questions truthfully by mistake, Leff aces his by not thinking at all. Hobbstweedle is out of diamonds, so Paxon makes the records show the gems were stolen by quasits. Bellatrix must stay with Gelf indefinitely to keep the secret and neither is thrilled. Sazed researches trance states and is pointed at the Starilaskur military library.

events.title: Lirael Learns to Fly
events.summary: After two hours of checklists, Screech lets Lirael take a Shuriken up. The drow out-turns him and paints his cockpit with paintballs.
events.detail: Haste and a little sorcery let Lirael brake in front of Screech, drop below and shoot, then spin the fighter without losing momentum for the winning hit. Screech calls him a natural and says he has lost a lot of money. Across the village Brand studies warforged anatomy with Clockwork, who has no use for sentimentality, and starts designing warforged limbs for Faird in his wheelchair. Monty O'Brien, freshly revived, invites Brand to learn elemental engines.

events.title: Meriel Dies on the Bridge
events.summary: The librarian waves to Lirael from across the river, carrying something his father left behind. She never reaches the Daily Grind.
events.detail: Lirael finds her on the bridge with an arrow through her throat. The arrow carries a silence spell; his shouts make no sound. Witnesses describe a man in a black suit and a long-nosed mask jumping into the water. The military police tackle him until he remembers he is a Sentinel and shows his badge. Her coworker Mercy promises to check the records quietly. Back home his friends are high on Larkleaf and making potions.

events.title: Paxon Names The Even Hand
events.summary: The mask matches an expensive assassin tied to House Thuranni whom no living person has met. Paxon also has three names from a disbanded regiment.
events.detail: The Royal Ardev Regiment ran a night exercise in the Boranex forest right after the demons appeared, then was disbanded four days later with its men still on the payroll. Lirael recognises nearly every name: conscripts from his home town. Three remain in Wroat: the blacksmith Murphy Gravewood, his literature teacher Gauss Hog and his school friend Kal Valvier. Nedira trains Sazed in Sentinel signals and gives him ten years of letters and drawings from Prowlstone, the village his warning saved.

events.title: Mercy Killed, the Records Burned
events.summary: The second librarian dies by arrow and the records room goes up in flames. An hour later Murphy Gravewood is dead too.
events.detail: Eloria gives the party two scrolls of speak with dead. Police Chief Torg is drowning in work but accepts help and sends beat cops for Gauss Hog and Kal. In the morgue Meriel's corpse says Lirael's father left a statue with runes and everyone knew she went to that cafe after work. At Murphy's house the lock was picked expertly and three bodies lie inside. The feeling of being watched follows the party through the streets of Wroat.

events.title: Gauss Hog's House Explodes
events.summary: Sazed spots binoculars glinting from a rooftop and chases a dark figure through Wroat. The house he was heading for erupts before anyone arrives.
events.detail: Brand and Sazed see the glint from Murphy's roof. Sazed jumps down and runs; Brand leaps onto the carriage and Tauren whips the horses. The explosion throws Sazed and a police officer to the ground. On a rooftop Brand finally sees The Even Hand clearly before he vanishes toward Kal Valvier's house. The carriage races to beat him there.

events.title: Kal Dies Four Times
events.summary: Sazed keeps reviving Lirael's school friend and the assassin keeps killing him, finally taking his head. Then Click Clack's axe splits the killer open.
events.detail: The Even Hand offers to let the party go if they hand over Kal. Smoke bombs, rooftop crossbow shots and two flesh-and-blood assassins follow; Lirael's hunger of hadar kills one and the moronic elf cop Click Clack the other. Sanctuary does not save Kal. Mortally wounded, the assassin's mask falls to show a black metal warforged face with red eyes that go dark as he sparks out. In Meriel's book bag they find Lirael Sr's obelisk, carved with runes like the demon portal. Click Clack resigns from the police with stick-figure reports behind him and gets a guest pass to Hobbstweedle.

events.title: The Rune Transmits a Soul
events.summary: Clockwork finds The Even Hand's rune does not hold his mind; it broadcasts it. Three intact runes would triangulate him.
events.detail: Gauss Hog tells Blazehelm the regiment's real mission: a classified strike on a demon-infested site where they bombed the circle as a Balor was emerging. Imps in stolen Sentinel gear firebomb the house in revenge for their village. Paxon's book lets Lirael decode one rune on the obelisk, older than the circle: it says dream. Eloria explains a form they definitely should not file to keep Kal under gentle repose.

events.title: The Paxon Painting Heist
events.summary: Dyll says no pranks, so the party recruits Screech, three gnomes, Eloria and Clockwork to copy Paxon's portrait, draw on it and hang it in the main hall.
events.detail: Fizbark distracts Paxon when supplies arrive, Spingus gets them into the kitchen and up the dumbwaiter, Dandy conjures a Beholder illusion to pull the guards. Eloria forges the documents and supplies a scroll of facsimile, ecstatic to be included; Clockwork brings glue. Invisible in the potion room they lift a scroll of comprehend languages and the Amulet of Compulsive Truth. At 8am the next morning the painting is unveiled and even Blazehelm laughs. Spingus informs them they now owe the gnomes.

events.title: The Tomb of Centarrel
events.summary: Paxon's hidden teleporter opens onto a tomb for the dragons of Centarrel and the soldiers who killed them in 968.
events.detail: The graves are dated the 8th to 13th of Eyre 968, the Day the Walls Fell. Among them lie High Marshall Elmor Daerthane, Thaldamir's father, and Cedric Ironhard, Gelf's father. Deeper in, clockwork wyrmlings guard a sealed dragon skull. A secret exit leads to the Hobbstweedle cemetery. After the dragons died, the rest left Khorvaire; the Guns of Wroat went up in 971 and the Sentinels were formed in 972.

events.title: Bellatrix Is Dead
events.summary: Blazehelm comes to the house himself: Bellatrix and her roommate were killed overnight and a note was left behind.
events.detail: She had been sent home against advice, annoyed at being kept in town. Brand voices concern about Paxon and Blazehelm explains Paxon annoyed the military into hiring him, prison stint included, and believes in the party. The Kingsblade and the Pillar of Dawn are leaving to fight a Karrnathi fleet. A silence arrow and a note from The Even Hand had already been found in the door days earlier; his tracks vanish into the river and the sewers.

events.title: The Moonwatch Departs
events.summary: Promoted to Petty Officers First Class, the party lifts off on their own ship with Screech as Master Chief and captain.
events.detail: Beazle is helmsman, Lirael co-helm, Brand engineer, Sazed communications and navigation, Sorenson head of security, Erald intelligence officer. Eleanor hands Brand a hand-typed manual of the upgrades; Clockwork gives him an all-purpose tool. Eloria gives Sazed the Wildheart Claw tattoo and Sheldor gives Lirael the Bloodwell Vial. Blazehelm adds 400 gold. Beezel has stolen the Major's whiskey and cigars for the occasion.

events.title: Evil in the Mirrors
events.summary: Brand's detect good and evil lights up every mirror on the ship. Lirael looks four times and passes out.
events.detail: Nothing like this happened in Hobbstweedle. Bigger mirrors feel more evil. A detour over the Yedani prison does not strengthen the aura. The crew throws every mirror overboard except one makeup mirror, which goes inside Chester. Cromwell turns up having passed out drunk aboard. Dandy the gnome chef is furious that Erald's cookies are good, and the ship's band plays Canuck songs into the night.

events.title: Steve the Skycracker
events.summary: Pirates ambush the Moonwatch over the Dagger River. A blue dragon destroys them and turns on the ship for trespassing in his sky.
events.detail: Lirael speaks to the dragon telepathically. Steve insists they belong on the ground. Pushing the compressor harder than it should go, Screech knocks the dragon tumbling, and Steve departs demanding they ask permission before flying again. Beezel sleeps through the whole thing. The compressor lets the Moonwatch boost for an hour twice a day with Brand on the engine.

events.title: Lirael Sr's Den
events.summary: Home at last, Lirael's sister calls him the murderer and his mother smokes through the hard conversation. The basement holds his father's whole descent.
events.detail: Ardev's air traffic control answers in nonsense and mercenaries of the Dragons Claw do not recognise the badge; police officers Jazz Chism and the warforged Mustang escort the party in. The magic society is now Fark's Bargain Whores. In the den, journals trace the general's obsession with the Dreamweaver and the Shadow Mirror. Comprehend languages reads the obelisk: the Gate to Shadows and Dreams, the Reflection of the Mirror, the Light of the Way, Beware of Knowledge. Lighting the obelisk opens a hidden door and a maddening puzzle.

events.title: Slaad Dad
events.summary: An elevator descends into an anti-magic field and a secret office where Lirael's father says he gave up. Sazed steps between them.
events.detail: The father becomes a slaad and opens with a fireball. Brand enlarges Sazed. Losing, the slaad goes invisible, shrinks and rides the elevator up; Sazed crams his giant body up the chimney and the party ambushes it at the top. The office has a pedestal with a slot for the obelisk and a diamond-shaped hole. Brand learns slaads obey whoever holds their control gem. Lirael uses suggestion to get his hoarding mother onto the ship and she makes him promise never to spell her again.

events.title: Ants, Birds and Tighty Whities
events.summary: Mercenaries harass Lirael's old crush Xera at the Turckle and Churckle. The party drugs them with talk-with-ants and bird potions.
events.detail: Captain Ellis of Morganth's Dragons Claw flips Xera's skirt. Lirael wins the battle of insults; outside, ants command the men to lick a spilled drink while Xera pulls down Ellis's pants to reveal hearts on his underwear. A potion of irresistibility to birds brings every bird in Ardev, and the dishwasher Neebus. Jazz detects the magic but Mustang talks him down. A reporter named Grib Grimley takes notes. Felicia storms off after Lirael finally speaks to her, and a quasit under threat points to the burned shifter village Stones Throw.

events.title: Gynn at the Cannith Forge
events.summary: Brand's nephew Brokk works for House Cannith now. A mephit turns out to be a glabrezu who wants him, and Lirael slips the ring of random teleportation onto the demon.
events.detail: Barry Baritone, a warforged built with Cannith and Broadhelm tech, leads them to the forge after his concert. The Right Hand, Merrix D'Cannith's emissary, and his owl Archimedes warn them about the Dragons Claw. Gynn knocks Sazed out in a round before Lirael activates the ring and sends him somewhere. Brokk refuses to board Brand's ship and takes refuge in the castle. Brand gets drunk in the bar's basement with Filgar the wererat, who punches birds for a living. Jeff the cursed frog man arrives, annoyed at having run the whole way.

events.title: Felicia Taken
events.summary: Lirael's house is wrecked. Turckle's flask, Felicia's purse and the teleportation ring lie on the floor; Gynn dragged two bodies away.
events.detail: Identify shows the ring sent Gynn to the Gorgis house. The trail vanishes, as glabrezus can fly. The clocktower watchman saw where the demon went. Strays follow the party all night and an owl circles overhead. A cat jumps on Sazed's shoulder and grows agitated as they near the castle, where the mercenaries plan to kill them.

events.title: The White Stag
events.summary: A stag with a crescent moon on its brow leads Sazed alone into the forest and reveals itself as The Bloodsinger of the Covenant of Emberfall.
events.detail: The radical shifter group believes modern society must be destroyed for shifters to survive, and that the Dreamweaver can be used. They are working with the Dragons Claw with no loyalty to it. The Bloodsinger wants Sazed. He warns of deep darkness in Ardev from the Dark Six, the Fury in particular, and names Fark's Bargain Whores as an inflection point. Dozens of eyes watch from the trees as he turns into air. Back on the ship Lirael finds Xera asleep in his bed and covers her with a blanket.

events.title: The Lost Mausoleum of Ardev
events.summary: Behind a sealed cellar passage lies the tomb of Alton Ardev, who led outcast drow from Sharn to build a town for all races, half above ground and half in Khyber.
events.detail: Lirael steals the morning's hit piece from the Ardev Watch while invisible. Detect good and evil finds an abandoned house full of demon sign and Felicia's Blood of Vol charm. Murals show Alton among drow and goblinoids, the flight from Sharn, and Alton pleading before the King. Sazed sprints 110 feet in twelve seconds and kicks five imps to death. The weresharks Topek and Wylon prowl the halls, wrong somehow, and the annoying old imp Shrimp Diggery, killed days ago, sings about it over bottles of ancient holy water.

events.title: The Fury Ritual
events.summary: Fark is a succubus. With Gynn she has strung up Turckle, the Gorgises, Neer and Elk, and bound Felicia above a portal as a vessel for the Fury.
events.detail: The Fury's spectral form grows more solid as the ritual runs. Lirael destroys the corpses anchoring the trance and misty-steps his chicken-shaped sister out of the circle; in a flash of light Brand and Sazed see their gods and Lirael sees Felicia as a child. The portal dies. Fark is absorbed into it and Gynn is killed. Felicia's latent sorcery erupts in an unintended fireball; she mutilates Gynn's corpse until calm emotions breaks her into sobbing. Brand takes 49 damage from a bone devil in one turn as the party flees down an underground river to the lake.

events.title: All of Ardev vs the Bone Devils
events.summary: Police, mercenaries, druids, two weresharks and Auntie Bees with a million bees meet the devil as it digs up through the abandoned house.
events.detail: Captain Flowers deploys every officer; The Right Hand brings Morganth, Brokk and Barry under a one-day truce. The Bloodsinger arrives as a triceratops. The bone devil summons a second. Together friends and enemies destroy both. Reporters Grib Grimley and Helena Braithwind watch from the edge. Afterwards nothing changes with Brokk or Morganth, but The Right Hand is impressed with Brand and the Bloodsinger with Sazed, and Auntie Bees chases the mercenaries off for taking her castle.

events.title: Fey-Lynn's Magic Society
events.summary: In the Kel House basement Fey-Lynn insists Karrnath controls the Dreamweaver and interrogates Lirael about his possession. Sazed sees anger flash across her face.
events.detail: Oberoth the Guardian, ridden by Snarky Chark and Shrimp, had cleared the mausoleum's abishai with them. In the square Morganth offers Lirael a place in the Dragons Claw, calls them fated foes and slips him a scroll of see invisibility. Posters announce Thaddeus Cannith's speech and free records. Wilford Chism, Auntie Threadwood, Neebus and The Right Hand attend the meeting; Lirael reveals he can detect the possessed with detect thoughts and Fey-Lynn is fascinated. The party agrees to return in the morning and read her mind.

events.title: Stones Throw: Children in the Well
events.summary: The shifter village is ash and a pile of radiant-burned corpses. A treant named Eldgrave says there are kids in the well.
events.detail: Eldgrave tells them it was the Silver Flame, young and powerful warriors from all sides in the dead of night, not the elderly moderates in town. Brand's ingenuity, Sazed's agility and the treant's strength lift the rock and pry the plug. Eight children aged two to five and ten-year-old Skye Amberwood have hidden there a week. Sazed knew her father Glade and wins her trust, but will not tell her who survived. Brand shoots down Archimedes with ray of frost on the way back. Lirael dreams of his father saying only: the Gate.

events.title: Phase Two
events.summary: Lirael climbs to Xera's window, tells her Turckle is dead, takes her necklace, and reads Fey-Lynn's mind: possessed, and taking his mother out for tea.
events.detail: Xera received the necklace in an unaddressed letter a year ago. Another mind nearby is reading Lirael's; he fails to probe it and flees with Xera. Men in plague masks set fire to his house and ride off in an armored carriage. Mustang, bristling with arrows from clocktower snipers, bursts onto the Moonwatch: Felicia Sr has been kidnapped. Jyo, a Sentinel sucked through a sinkhole outside the World Scar, simply walks aboard.

events.title: Ambushed by Ellis
events.summary: At the cemetery stairs to upper Ardev, Ellis's wizard holds Lirael in place and the mercenary beats him unconscious.
events.detail: From the Moonwatch the crew later sees Ellis and his wizard dead in the street, killed brutally by The Even Hand, who takes Lirael for himself. The Ardev Watch runs a fresh hit piece headlined Mass Murderer Summons Demons in Ardev, crediting Morganth with slaying them. Helena Braithwind signs it; Grib Grimley has stopped publishing.

events.title: Mustang Betrays Them on the Carriage
events.summary: Screech drops the party onto a fleeing armored carriage. On its roof The Even Hand is waiting, and Mustang has been one of his bodies all along.
events.detail: Both warforged are knocked off and climb back on with grapple hooks. The top floor fireballs; Sazed smashes in through a window, scatters ball bearings and finds no hostages, only an arcane safe that is a portal to the Astral Plane. Mustang shuts off his personality core to shove Brand off; his leg struts barely save him. Ahead a lightning rail bristles with ballistas and anti-air cannons. The Even Hand says they are out of their depth and that he has been living invisibly on the Moonwatch. The party escapes with the safe and sees, through it, a train car where Mustang and The Even Hand close another.

events.title: Paxon: A Black-Booked Train
events.summary: Lirael and his mother are being arrested on bunk charges. An unfinished lightning rail was switched on last night and reaches the end of its track in six hours.
events.detail: Paxon finds Mustang had no record before Ardev and advises against killing the plague soldiers, who are probably Brelish. Eloria will land in Ardev at 0815 tomorrow. Brand builds a hinge-removal machine, two train decouplers and a ray to reactivate Mustang's positronic brain. A tracking charm found on the ship is given to Mr. Beaks the pigeon to carry away. A dreamwoven Lirael calls Erald's stone and threatens Ember and the Sagewoods.

events.title: Xera and Fey-Lynn Beheaded
events.summary: Jyo the spider slips into the train car and is flicked off the roof. The party storms the portal past an invisible beholder, and the hostages pay for it.
events.detail: Sazed stuns the beholder and they run by it. The Even Hand promised to do to the women what he did to Kal if anyone took a step. He and Mustang decapitate both. Jyo decouples the rear car as a Flock changeling steps out. Beezel's bear army attacks; The Even Hand kills Maisha the bear. Cromwell climbs out of a barrel he fell asleep in, drunk, and joins the fight.

events.title: The Even Hand Dies
events.summary: Brand's ray wakes Mustang's own mind long enough to strike his master and shout that it is a trap. In the astral car, Brand's lightning and Sazed's fists finish the assassin.
events.detail: The Even Hand is intrigued that his body has a mind of its own and plans to wipe it. He flees through the portal; a dreamwoven, invisible Lirael counterspells Brand and fireballs where he stood. Bears Telos and Gruff enter and are possessed. The Even Hand takes Felicia Sr hostage, waiting for everyone to be taken, until Brand reveals himself with lightning while Sazed pulls her clear. Sazed stuns Lirael; both Xal'ris go into the bag of holding with five minutes of air. Cromwell's mage hand later retrieves the assassin's rune.

events.title: Jyo Torn Apart by Bears
events.summary: The possessed bears leave the portal and tear the Sentinel to pieces a moment before the party can kill them.
events.detail: Cromwell is down and the Flock shove at him. The beholder exits the portal. Sazed races to the roof to heal Cromwell while Brand calls the battered Moonwatch off. Protection from evil and good gives Lirael ten minutes of freedom; a lucky hypnotic pattern entrances the beholder. Jyo, Xera and Fey-Lynn go into the bag of holding and Brand cracks Mustang's chest for his rune. In the dream prison, the Dreamweaver shows Lirael Ellis's death and lets him watch Xera and Fey-Lynn fall.

events.title: The Skull Knight and the Turtle Fortress
events.summary: Black mist, hooves, and hellfire orbs blow the fleeing Flock apart. A knight on an undead horse has come to save them, then judge them.
events.detail: The train is racing toward a gigantic turtle-shaped mobile fortress. Brand decouples the last car; Lirael thunderwaves to slow it. Sazed plants the smokepowder satchel on the train's elemental ring and jumps, and the Skull Knight catches him and rides him back. Lirael's mage hand signals the Moonwatch through the smoke. The train hits the fortress and the explosion destroys the head before the whole thing turns invisible.

events.title: The Skull Knight's Judgment
events.summary: On the Moonwatch's deck the knight asks cryptic questions, judges them worthy to carry the Obelisk and the Gate, and walks his sword into Lirael's mind.
events.detail: Lirael's father carried the artifacts before them. The party is careful of knowledge, has seen half the light, and their minds are barricaded. Inside the dream prison the Dreamweaver rants at the knight, who silences it by asking whether it knows its true name, then frees Lirael, something he cannot do often. He names Brand the chosen of Dol Dorn, warns the Dreamweaver corrupts knowledge to feed on it, and promises to kill them if they learn too much and fall. The wizard of time believes they may stop the key from turning.

events.title: Lilya the Guide
events.summary: Obelisk and Gate slot into the hidden desk and black light fills the den. A wayfinder compass, its lodestone hidden under the Kel House, wakes a drow girl who will guide them into Khyber.
events.detail: The note in the empty slot reads I Tag Ye Cosmic, an anagram of The Magic Society. Skye is stunned to find Sazed alive and he earns major points. Ardev now has checkpoints, a kids' curfew at nine and an adults' curfew at eleven, and mercenaries throwing dead imps in a cart. In the Silver Flame church Bimble Niblet, the quasit Sazed spared, has repented. Wilford Chism felt the Fury's presence vanish yesterday, replaced by some stranger evil.

events.title: Jazz in the Fold, Flowers Under Threat
events.summary: The Valviers' last gold sits in police evidence under a false name. Reading Captain Flowers's mind, the party hears the mercenaries will kill his family.
events.detail: The Valvier house is half torched and signed by demons. Jazz is told about Xera, Mustang and the Dreamweaver and agrees to be their man inside. The Right Hand, furious that Brand killed his owl, silently orders Daedalus activated; a warforged eagle shadows them home. Brokk leaves superior armor plating on the Moonwatch with a note calling it even. Lirael buys Brokk's last two diamonds with his badge.

events.title: Xera and Fey-Lynn Return
events.summary: One diamond, a ring of spell storing and a twinned raise dead bring both women back. Xera finds her bearings quickly; Fey-Lynn does not know who she is.
events.detail: Eloria arrived at dawn and hugged a nervous Sazed. The tortle reporter Dell Quickfoot has found no record of Lirael's crimes and says Grib Grimley vanished after promising him something. Brand beats Screech in a repair bet with Brokk's grudging help. Zenya Kel wakes, tries to take Brand hostage, then will not stop flirting. Xera later kisses Lirael for reviving her, which Felicia finds disgusting.

events.title: Hearthsfire Behind the Illusion
events.summary: Only a raven's call passes the warding illusion. Inside, Sazed's old village believes he is alive after all, and the children of Stones Throw find a home.
events.detail: Elder Falken Sagewood is debating with the Covenant's Bear Wildheart whether to strip Carrk Moonrunner of the Ring of Siberys. Sazed vouches for Carrk, who weeps over being lured away by a false fox totem and gives him a Cloak of Displacement. Spring Sagewood, communing with the warding tree Garfan, likens the village's uneasy Covenant alliance to Sazed's with the Sentinels and senses something attacking Brand and Lirael's minds. Falken warns never to let changelings in. Skye chooses Sazed as her loreguard teacher. The Bear quietly warns: beware Carrk.

events.title: The Truth Amulet at the EPTF
events.summary: Captain Opal Dane-Oriel's paladins draw steel at Lirael's name. The Amulet of Compulsive Truth makes them stand down.
events.detail: A revived Flock changeling named Bravewind as his village, raided six weeks ago. Paxon traced the rail switch to the Starilaskur Military Railway Junction at midnight on the 21st. Dane remembers the Watchers of the Gate turned to gore a year ago; Lirael proves he was possessed, and Brand proves he was framed. The Extra Planar Task Force had dismissed the Dreamweaver because Lirael Sr's ravings put them off it. Brand notices a portrait of a warforged named Bulwark Broadhelm.

events.title: Elfina Daelmourn
events.summary: The Grand Witch's father died at Lirael's hands. She explains the Watchers were celestial warlocks of the Fury guarding the Gate for a worthy obelisk bearer.
events.detail: Captured trying to restart the cult in the Witches Waltz, she lost her powers mid-fight when the Fury cried for help and then screamed in anguish; her patron has been silent since. She knows the knowledge curse and the Skull Knight. Detect thoughts shows she has decided to put off killing herself now that someone takes her seriously. Dane says the forge is everything to this town, and Ember runs it.

events.title: Gelard Greenly's Overdue Books
events.summary: The awkward librarian Arkhan reveals the trance-state books were last borrowed by a young, slightly crazed wizard hunting the Dreamweaver.
events.detail: Sazed learns a crude Bloodmoon Ritual. Gelard has also asked Ember for items to relieve a possession he will not describe. The party keeps the books overdue as bait. Brand studies the lightning rail's history. On the street Brand warns a young dwarf against enlisting and is told the draft will take him anyway; everyone salutes.

events.title: Ember's Forty-Year Suit
events.summary: Brand's twin sister greets him coldly, then embraces him, then opens a wall to reveal the armor she has built for him for forty years.
events.detail: The bad news first, over dwarven ale: their father went paranoid after Brand's imprisonment, locked the forge's inventions away, built the warforged Bulwark for no reason and never raised him. Art left for House Cannith and Mason and Cutter make ever stranger things. Ember's daughter Ash has an elf father, which earns Brand the Ring of Cure Racism. The new suit never worked until Brand seats Onatar's holy core in it. He gives his old suit to his sister and they have a little manly cry. Skye is slightly drunk.

events.title: Aundairians in the Alley
events.summary: Killian Gavrin's crew race the party to the Moonwatch. Hypnotic dancing dwarves, an immovable rod and a frog man who swallows people end it.
events.detail: Brand misses a jump, rides a mine cart, swings from a crane and falls through a couple's roof. Lirael pins the carriage with the rod. Sazed kills EEEEE the Dwarf in a Can and takes a battle axe to the chest from Killian. Jeff swallows Kynds, is told to spit him out, swallows Killian, same. Killian surrenders unarmed while Kynds escapes across the rooftops. Before Sergeant Taggart's police can act, Killian taunts that King Boranel's secret Sentinels cannot stay secret forever; Brand knocks him out.

events.title: Carrk's Cloak Connects to Another Plane
events.summary: Brand feels dark magic as Sazed attunes. Identify shows a cloak of connect mind linked to a being elsewhere, presumably the Dreamweaver.
events.detail: Divination shows Lirael a red dragon in blinding light telling him his mistrust is misplaced. Eloria has built a makeshift chapel to Dol Arrah; Zenya has painted a gaudy pink banner reading We Don't Die. Killian is tied up below with Skye and Eloria standing guard. Felicia resents being kept off patrol until Lirael explains she is too powerful, which suitably strokes her ego. Xera is waiting in Lirael's room and everyone knows.

events.title: Unabombers and a Gorgon
events.summary: Station master Chaton E'Clair opens a package of catnip and dies. The same conductors deliver one to Ember, and open the carriage on a gorgon.
events.detail: Hidden in the bag of holding with a breathing tube, Brand and Lirael ride an invisible Sazed into the railway junction, where a freshly cleared track holds military bootprints and orange fur. Sazed rides the bombers' carriage as they tear off their clothes and change faces: changelings in military police uniforms. Lirael warns Ember by message; Sazed cuffs the changeling as Brand is blown up beside his sister. The gorgon petrifies a gate guard. Sazed dives off a cliff to kill the second changeling and Ember's flamethrower, haste and Brand's missile launcher finish the beast.

events.title: Flashback in the Witches Waltz
events.summary: Freed from the EPTF, Elfina leads them to the cult's hall. Lirael collapses on the threshold and finally remembers the massacre.
events.detail: Sergeant Taggart has joined the investigation; Beezel's interrogation of the horses traces the changelings to First Tower. The Soul Street Hooligan steals the Ring of Cure Racism mid-conversation and escapes behind a hypnotic saxophone solo. In the vision, Maldroc Daelmourn's mirrors become doorways into the astral sea, the Dreamweaver enters Lirael, and he tears the Watchers apart and burns the library. He runs and hides crying in a cart until Brand and Sazed talk him down. They smash every mirror and recover Maldroc's writings from under the floorboards.

events.title: Kynds Takes Killian Back
events.summary: Aundairian hobgoblins hold a charmed Beezel at crossbow point on the Moonwatch's deck. Rather than a bloodbath, the party hands over the captain.
events.detail: Sazed calls Kynds a friend and gets nowhere. Afterwards Sazed kicks a crate in the hold, torn between Sentinel duty, old loyalties and Skye. Eloria tells him her village Ashhaven was wiped out in an early Aundairian invasion and they have a cute cuddle. Brand gives Beezel a pep talk. Fey-Lynn has been calmed by Screech's stories of their exploits.

events.title: Steve and Bob's Lost Sons
events.summary: Two dragons land on the Moonwatch. Their sons are calling themselves Ragnarok of Eberron and Balthazar of the Wastes and were last seen near Ardev.
events.detail: Steve the Skycracker says the party owes him their lives for not killing them before; Bob the Blazebringer is disgusted by his son's name. Fetching the boys is too lowly for dragons but a legendary quest for mortals, and might buy free passage. That morning Felicia, wreathed in fire, had demanded to know why a woman painted in the Fury's runes was aboard; Elfina locked herself in her room. Brand and Dandy's tea machine lets them hear squirrels insult them.

events.title: A Message for the Lighted One
events.summary: Mr. Beaks's new girlfriend turns to Skye and speaks: return to your home, your family need not die in vain, bring the Guarded One.
events.detail: Thaddeus's gaudy ship The Empyrean sits in the Moonwatch's usual spot and Brand sees Art's workmanship in it. Daedalus watches from above. Guarded One is what the Bloodsinger calls Sazed, so the stag wants both of them at Stones Throw after the speech. Zenya has done Skye's makeup, which is quickly scrubbed off. Brand is painted purple and given the hat of slight disguise.

events.title: Fey-Lynn's Debrief: Three Phases
events.summary: Stable at last, Fey-Lynn explains what the Dreamweaver used her for: misdirect the magic society, feed The Right Hand false data, watch the Xal'ris.
events.detail: Phase one was to mislead the party when they arrived; it noted everything they revealed and was enraged to learn Lirael could read minds. Phase two was kidnapping Lirael's mother to bait a possession trap. Phase three was simply killing them. Screech has been sleeping on his floor so she can have the bed. Wilford Chism arrives shaken by a mushroom vision from his god and asks to stay; he explains Reconciliation Day, proving the elderly Ardev Silver Flame could never have burned Stones Throw.

events.title: Captain Flowers' Black Order
events.summary: The police captain admits the portal strike was a classified order that must be obeyed without question. He never learned who sent it.
events.detail: Barry Baritone has gone missing after a dinner on The Empyrean with Thaddeus, Art Broadhelm and a tiefling butler named Silvania. Sorenson reports Thaddeus wears an anti-magic amulet and was charming but fake. The whole Gorgis family is dead. Through Flowers's sending stone Morganth asks why Ellis died so publicly, announces Art is coming with Thaddeus to review the mercenary-police integration, and asks the party not to fly their ship or cause an incident today. They reluctantly agree.

events.title: Thaddeus Is Coming to Town
events.summary: Posters paper every wall of Ardev. The man who stole forty years of Brand's life will give a speech at the opening of the House Cannith Recording Studio.
events.detail: The Ardev Watch celebrates Lirael's departure and urges everyone to attend. Brand has been painted purple and hides under the hat of slight disguise. Daedalus and a flock of birds watch the Moonwatch. Quests crowd the board: follow Lilya into Khyber, find the dragons' sons, meet Dell at nine, solve Grib Grimley's disappearance, free Felicia Sr, and return to the Bloodsinger with the Lighted One. The notes end here, reconstructed a year later from memory.
